X4 Community Patches

by: flpstrike (implementation) and hasungkee (sprites)

hasungkee's sprite credit applies to Zero Buster (X5).

Includes Zero Buster (X5), HUD with Real Transparency, Hybrid Buster,
and Plasma Ball Boss Filter. All four are built in. Players select their
original Mega Man X4 (USA) disc in the normal game-image picker; no IPS,
BPS or Xdelta patch file is needed. The on-disk image is never modified.

Enable each feature independently on the Mods page, then start a fresh
session. The patches use your original USA disc and support Japanese Voices and
Japanese Media. Save states
are specific to the selected patch plan; native memory-card saves remain
separate.
